rules.name: Identity Verification Gate
rules.statement: A Customer Profile must not be activated until a valid government-issued identity document is verified.
rules.condition: during onboarding or profile status change to active
exceptions: Government-issued ID verification fails due to technical system outage
Customer provides alternative verified identity via trusted third-party service
rules.if_violated: The profile remains in pending status and cannot initiate any Order Request
rules.rationale: Prevents unverified individuals from accessing financial and delivery services, mitigating fraud and regulatory risk.

parameters.name: max_verification_attempts
parameters.description: Maximum number of allowed verification retries before manual review

rules.name: Fraud Flag Suspension
rules.statement: A Customer Profile must not be used to create an Order Request if the profile is flagged for fraud or suspended.
exceptions: Suspension is lifted by a Compliance Officer before order submission
Fraud flag is a false positive cleared by automated review within 1 hour
rules.if_violated: The Order Request is automatically rejected and the customer is notified of the restriction
rules.rationale: Protects the platform and merchants from financial loss and reputational damage associated with fraudulent activity.

parameters.name: fraud_threshold_score
parameters.description: Risk score level above which the profile is automatically flagged

rules.name: Profile Data Immutability
rules.statement: Archived Customer Profiles must not be modified, and all historical data must be retained indefinitely.
rules.condition: after the profile status transitions to Archived
exceptions: Correction of a clerical error in the metadata (e.g., archive date) by an Administrator
Legal requirement to disclose specific data points to a regulatory body
rules.if_violated: The system logs the unauthorized attempt and triggers an audit alert to the Security Team
rules.rationale: Ensures data integrity for legal compliance, audit trails, and accurate historical analysis.

parameters.name: retention_period_years
parameters.description: Minimum duration data must be retained after archival

rules.name: Contact Channel Consistency
rules.statement: All critical notifications regarding Order Request status or Payment Settlement must be sent via the primary contact method defined in the Customer Profile.
rules.condition: during notification dispatch for critical events
exceptions: Primary contact method is invalid or unreachable for more than 24 hours
Customer explicitly opts out of specific notification types in their preferences
rules.if_violated: The notification is queued for retry; if retry fails, a secondary channel is used with a warning flag
rules.rationale: Ensures customers receive timely updates regarding their orders and payments, maintaining trust and reducing support tickets.

parameters.name: retry_attempts
parameters.description: Number of times the system attempts to send via the primary channel before switching
